decisionsTitle: «Elită» from the start: a tick on the staff entry and on an invitation, said to nobody
decisionsSection:
**The owner, 2026-11-04:** «înscriu pe cineva de mână, sau trimit invitație, ar trebui să pot bifa direct că e elită, dar asta e ceva intern — ei nu știu asta, că sunt bifați ca elite». Until now a registration was marked «Elită» only afterwards, from the registrations list's «⋮» (§897): enter the person, find the row, mark it.

**Decision.**

- **The staff entry's «Elită» tick.** «Adaugă o înscriere» draws a real tick box «Elită» / “Elite” under «Direct pe lista de așteptare», with one line: «Intern: persoana nu vede marcajul; schimbă doar cum se tipărește BIB-ul.» — for the Administrator only (`canManageRegistrations`), the role that marks (§897). Every way of that form takes it — the ordinary entry, «Direct pe lista de așteptare» (§872), the desk's fast track — and the one-press «Adaugă pe lista de așteptare» (§872, §888) has the same tick. Each confirmation dialog says «Marcat «Elită» — intern, persoana nu e anunțată.» in one quieter line, only while the box is ticked.
- **One transaction, one way of marking.** `admin-service.ts#createRegistrationByStaff` refuses `elite` from any other role — the Organizer and the volunteer at the desk included — with FORBIDDEN before anything is written, never dropping it silently (BR-REQ-060-01); the form comes back with every box kept (§315). Ticked, the entry and the mark are one transaction: `submitRegistration` and the `registration.created_by_staff` row, then `elite-mark.ts#writeRegistrationEliteMark` — the body «Marchează ca elită» itself now runs (`setRegistrationElite`), extracted so the three presses can never mark differently: the same column, the same `registration.elite_marked` row, the same re-ranking when «Apare în clasament» was unticked (§910), the public pages told after the commit — and, for the one-press «Adaugă pe lista de așteptare», whose entry runs inside its own transaction, told again once that one committed, so a page drawn in between keeps no old rows. A refused entry (the line full, a duplicate) leaves neither row nor mark. The trail adds `via: "entry"`. The fast track's paper confirmation stays its own step after it, as before; without the tick the entry runs exactly as before.
- **The invitation's «Elită» tick, per send.** «Trimite invitații» has «Elită» beside «Pe lista de invitați speciali» — one tick for the whole send, as that one is — and the dialog says «Înscrierile vor fi marcate «Elită» — intern, persoanele nu sunt anunțate.». Each invitation stores it (`event_invitations.elite`, migration 0194, expand only, false by default), and `event.invitation_sent` carries `elite: true`. When the invitation becomes a registration — the link's press (`invitations.ts#acceptInvitation`, after `seatInvitedRegistration`) or another route that takes it over (`service.ts#markInvitationAdopted`: the public form's confirmation, a staff entry, the desk, «Dă-i un loc acum») — that registration is marked in the same transaction through the same `writeRegistrationEliteMark`, the trail naming the Administrator who sent the invitation (`invited_by_staff_user_id`, null once that account is gone) with `via: "invitation"`. The public pages hear of a mark taken over this way with the place itself: the only public reads the mark changes — the start list, its counts and the results, for a restarted row whose club ticks (§910) it brings into force — are filed under `places` as well as `events`, and the place's move tells `places`. Withdrawn or past its deadline, an invitation marks nobody. «Invitații» wears the registrations list's own «Elită» chip (the medal, `StatusChip`): on an open invitation by the send's tick, and on an accepted one by the registration it became as that stands now — «Nu mai e elită» on the registration takes the chip off there too, «Marchează ca elită» on an ordinary invitation's registration puts it on — while the invitation keeps the send's tick as what was sent. The Organizer reads it there as on the list.
- **Internal.** No email, link page, form, «Înregistrările mele», declaration page or catalogue word the person reads says «elită»: the invitation's email reads the invitation by its id and renders nothing of the mark, and a test renders every email of both journeys and the person's own reads and finds no such word. The public pages are unchanged: a marked registration is named only by the person's own «Vreau să apar» (§910).
- **The rule documents.** `AGENTS.md` §15.11's paragraph on the elite mark names the two ticks and the `via`; CLAUDE.md's staff row already says the Administrator marks «at any time and in any state», which a mark from the start is.

**Refused.**

- **Telling the person.** The owner's own word: «e ceva intern». How a bib prints is the club's printing choice, and the mark moves no place, state or number the person would need to know of.
- **The tick for the Organizer or the desk.** The mark is the Administrator's (§897): the volunteer at the table enters walk-ins, the Administrator marks.
- **A tick per person in a send.** One per send, as «Pe lista de invitați speciali»: elites are invited in a send of their own.
- **A second marking path.** Writing `elite = true` into the new row's insert would skip the trail and the re-ranking; the extracted helper is the one write.

**An invitation is its own door — pinned (the owner, 2026-11-04: «trebuie să poată lumea să se înscrie prin invitație, chiar dacă înscrierile pe site sunt închise»).** Already so by §647 and §906 — an invitation's form is a staff channel, past «Înscrieri publice deschise», «Locurile libere le dau doar eu» and the registration window — and now held by a test (`tests/integration/registrations/elite-at-entry-and-invitation.test.ts`): with the switch unticked, offers-only ticked and the window closed, the public form is refused and nothing written, while an invitation is sent, its link reads open, it is accepted into a held place and signed.
changelogLine: - **«Elită» ticked at the entry and on an invitation** — «Adaugă o înscriere», «Adaugă pe lista de așteptare» and «Trimite invitații» have an «Elită» tick for the Administrator: the registration is marked from the start, exactly as «Marchează ca elită» marks it, and the person is told nothing. §NNN.

specsCriteria.text: Given the staff entry — the full form, ordinary, «Direct pe lista de așteptare» or the desk's fast track, or the one-press «Adaugă pe lista de așteptare» — when an Administrator ticks «Elită», then the registration lands in the state it would without the tick and is marked elite in the entry's own transaction, with one `registration.elite_marked` row under the Administrator holding `{ elite: true, via: "entry" }`, and a refused entry leaves no row and no mark; without the tick nothing is marked; any other role posting it — the Organizer and the volunteer at the desk included — is refused FORBIDDEN before anything is written, every box kept. Verification: integration `registrations/elite-at-entry-and-invitation.test.ts` (2026-11-04, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Given a send of invitations with «Elită» ticked, then each invitation of the send stores it and «Invitații» wears the «Elită» chip on it while it is open, and once accepted while the registration it became is marked — «Nu mai e elită» takes the chip off, «Marchează ca elită» on an ordinary invitation's registration puts it on; when it becomes a registration — by its link or by another route that takes it over — that registration is marked elite in the same transaction, the trail naming the Administrator who sent it with `via: "invitation"`; an invitation sent without it, withdrawn or past its deadline marks nobody. Verification: integration `registrations/elite-at-entry-and-invitation.test.ts` (2026-11-04, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Given a registration marked «Elită» at its entry or through its invitation, then it is the mark the registrations list's «⋮» puts on — the same column and audit action — and no email, link page, form or page of the person's own says «elită». Verification: integration `registrations/elite-at-entry-and-invitation.test.ts` (2026-11-04, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

batchLine: «Elită» ticked at the staff entry and on an invitation
